project.title: Workshop course seat bookings — controlled laboratory

requirements.text: Register sessions with a code, topic and number of available seats. Retain direct read and paginated listing.
Create a unique seat booking and atomically decrement the associated session's available seats only when sufficient seats exist. Read and list bookings.
Cancel a confirmed booking at most once and atomically return exactly its previously booked seats. The cancellation must be audited.
Expose a public technical health endpoint for the generated application.
Calendar scheduling, instructor allocation, student identities, waitlists, prices, payments, refunds and cancellation fees are outside this laboratory.

questions.question: Who may create bookings or cancel somebody else's booking in production?
What cancellation deadlines, refund rules and penalties should apply if future commerce is added?
How should time zones, time slots, overlapping sessions and instructor availability be represented?
